STAIR Spatiotemporal Fusion Framework (Luo et al., 2018)
Balanced 2×2 Methodological Architecture for Cloud Imputation and Daily High-Resolution Agricultural Synthesis

1. DATA ACQUISITION & QUALITY SCREENING

Primary Satellite Observations:
• Landsat 8 & 9: 30 m · 16-Day Revisit (NIR, Red, Green)
• MODIS MCD43A4: 500 m · Daily Coverage (Nadir BRDF)
• Clear Reference Scene (t₁): Cloud-free structural baseline
• Full-Season Archive: Multi-temporal training catalog
• Study Area AOI: 7 km × 7 km Extent (Clayton Township, MI)

Quality Screening & Water Guard:
• QA_PIXEL Bitmasks: Cloud, Shadow, Dilated & Cirrus flags
• 6-Pixel Buffer Dilation to catch diffuse haze & shadow edges
• JRC Global Surface Water + NDWI Guard: Protects lakes

Quality Partitioned Layers:
• Clear Surface Mask (C_f): Valid calibration pixels
• Cloud Gap Mask (C_g): Missing target pixels to restore

2. STAIR CLOUD IMPUTATION PIPELINE (SEC. 2.2)

Stage 2.2.1: Temporal Linear Interpolation:
• Nearest clear observations before (t_bef) and after (t_aft)
• Proportional weight: w = (t₀ − t_bef) / (t_aft − t_bef)
• Formula: L_linear = R(t_bef) + w × [ R(t_aft) − R(t_bef) ]
• Forward/backward fill fallback for season overpass boundaries

Stage 2.2.2a: Global Spatial Drift Correction:
• Temporal drift: Δ_temp = mean(L, C_f, t₀) − mean(L_linear, C_f, t₀)
• Spatial gap offset: Δ_spatial = mean(L, C_g, t₁) − mean(L, C_f, t₁)
• Formula: L_global = L_linear + (Δ_temp + Δ_spatial)

Stage 2.2.2b: Land-Cover Adaptive K-Means Correction:
• Unsupervised Weka K-Means (k = 4) clustering on clear day t₁
• Class-specific offsets: Δ_temp(c) & Δ_spatial(c) per crop type
• 1.5 px focal mean boundary feathering eliminates seamlines
• Formula: L_adaptive = L_linear + δ(c)

Output: ✓ 100% Cloud-Free Landsat Image (30 m Resolution)

3. SPATIOTEMPORAL DUAL FUSION ENGINE (SEC. 2.3)

Dual Reference Pair Selection:
• Golden Day (T₁): Concurrent clear Landsat (30 m) & MODIS (500 m)
• Post-Reference (T₂): Imputed Landsat (30 m) & MODIS (500 m)

Spatial Scale & Grid Alignment:
• Bilinear interpolation resamples 500 m MODIS to 30 m grid
• Aligns coordinates, projections, and pixel bounds to Landsat grid

Spatial Difference Residual Isolation:
• ε(T₁) = L(T₁) − M(T₁) & ε(T₂) = L̂(T₂) − M(T₂)
• Extracts 30 m farm field boundaries & crop rows blurred at 500 m

Proximity-Weighted Daily Synthesis:
• Time weights: w₁ = (T₂ − t_p) / (T₂ − T₁) ; w₂ = (t_p − T₁) / (T₂ − T₁)
• Formula: I(t_p) = M(t_p) + w₁·ε(T₁) + w₂·ε(T₂)
• Clamped to valid physical reflectance range [0.0, 1.0]

Output: ✓ Fused 30 m Daily Synthetic Product (Daily Phenology)

4. QUANTITATIVE VERIFICATION & DELIVERABLES

Ground-Truth Benchmark Proof:
• 1.5 km simulated cloud patch over 0% clear benchmark
• Multi-season validation across 6 phenological phases (2022)

Quantitative Accuracy Assessment:
• Evaluated inside cloud gap: MAE, RMSE, Pearson Correlation (R), R²
• Documented Gain: 20% to 40% error reduction over baseline

Geospatial Deliverables & Research Applications:
• Multi-band calibrated GeoTIFF stacks (EPSG:32616)
• Continuous daily NDVI agricultural time-series
• Ready for GIS ingestion in QGIS / ArcGIS

Flow Legend:
[Amber: Inputs] · [Cyan: Impute] · [Purple: Fusion] · [Green: Deliverables]
